data.title: Azizi Venice
data.about:
Embrace a rejuvenating lifestyle in Dubai South's golden sands, where each morning greets you in a stunning water-edge haven. This oasis features a sparkling lagoon, untouched beaches, a lively promenade, and top-tier entertainment. 

Azizi Venice's residences, with their upscale designs, beautifully reflect the surrounding nature. Expansive windows blend the interior with the exterior, highlighting the breathtaking water views and flowing waterfalls. Choose from a range of apartments, including Studios, and 1 to 3-bedroom units. These homes redefine apartment living, crafted for discerning individuals. 

Surrounded by verdant greenery and the calming sound of water, Azizi Venice offers diverse living spaces: Boulevard lagoon homes, urban water communities, beachfront villas, and an exclusive mansion island. With community beaches, water paths, and lagoons, it's a true haven of water wonders.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Water Inspired Living In Dubai
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Experience luxurious waterfront living in the heart of Dubai South, spanning 336 acres.
  • Enjoy convenient proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport and Emirates Road.
  • Discover a diverse community with residential neighborhoods, business zones, schools, healthcare, and recreation.
  • Benefit from direct access to a future dedicated Dubai Metro station.
  • Find yourself near the city's renowned malls, landmarks, entertainment, and leisure venues.
  • Explore a range of housing options, including boulevard apartments, a mansion island, clubhouse, family and lifestyle hotels.
  • Immerse yourself in cultural experiences with a 1,500-seat state-of-the-art opera house.
  • Stroll along a 700-meter climate-controlled pedestrian and vibrant retail boulevard.
  • Delight in Crystal Lagoon access for all buildings and a children's water theme park.
  • Enjoy various sports and leisure activities.
  • Choose from a wide selection of apartments, including studios, 1, 2, and 3 bedrooms, all featuring top-of-the-line appliances.

location_tile.title: The ultimate location in Dubai South
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Begin your day in a revitalizing oasis nestled within Dubai South's golden sands. This waterfront utopia is home to a radiant lagoon, immaculate beachfront, bustling boulevard, and premier entertainment options. Azizi Venice offers residences that are artfully designed to complement the natural scenery, featuring expansive windows that blur the lines between inside and outside, offering stunning views of the water and waterfalls.

  • 05 Mins Emirates Road
  • 07 Mins Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 10 Mins Dubai Parks and Resorts
  • 15 Mins The Palm Jebel Ali
  • 20 Mins Dubai Marina
